The '''Druess sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The sector contained the [[Ank Kit'aar system/Legends|Ank Kit'aar system]] along with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ank Kit'aar]].
